lines.text: Your world has expanded after\nbecoming Champion!
You can now fly up in the sky with [VAR COLOR(0006)]Charizard[VAR COLOR(0000)],\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]Aerodactyl[VAR COLOR(0000)], and [VAR COLOR(0006)]Dragonite[VAR COLOR(0000)] anywhere you want.
Hey, sorry to bug you while your\nworld’s expanding.
Now that you’ve successfully become Champion,\nI’ve got some news for you!
The [VAR COLOR(0006)]Master Trainers[VAR COLOR(0000)]—Trainers that have spent\ntheir whole careers training one specific\r\nPokémon—have appeared throughout Kanto.
I’d say challenging the Pikachu Master is a good\nplace to start.\c\nHead to Viridian Forest if you want to face her!
I’d say challenging the Eevee Master is a good\nplace to start.\c\nHead to Pokémon Road if you want to face her!
If you want to know the details, talk to me!
What do you want to know about\nthe Master Trainers?

The Master Trainers have each focused on
training one species of Pokémon.\c
They’re always thinking about the Pokémon
they’ve spent all that time with, so you should
be able to find them pretty easily.

If you have the same species of Pokémon as
them, you’ll be able to battle them, one-on-one.\c
Neither side will be allowed to use items, so it
will be a battle of pure skill!\c
If you win, you’ll receive a title and you’ll be
able to use it from that point on.
You can change the title you’re using at\nthe game company in Celadon City.\c\nShow it off during Link Battles!
